About.metaDescription: Naif Mutfak is a kitchen notebook of recipes made with simple ingredients, patience and step-by-step testing, in three languages.
About.title: Simple ingredients, patient hands, shared tables
About.intro: Naif Mutfak exists for recipes you can repeat at home with confidence. We share the joy of cooking unhurriedly with a few good ingredients, in Turkish, English and Arabic.
About.imageAlt: Hands kneading dough on a floured counter
About.story1: A recipe proves its worth not on the first try but the third or fifth time it comes out of your kitchen. Naif Mutfak grew from that idea: a calm kitchen notebook that cares more about recipes that truly work than about fancy styling.
About.story2: From sourdough to pistachio baklava, every recipe comes with weights, tips and the mistakes people commonly make. Our goal is to help you build hands that know the ingredients and can feel the dough.
About.principleSimpleBody: Every recipe starts with ingredients you can find at the corner shop. Few but well-chosen ingredients are half of a good result.
About.principleTestedBody: Before publishing, recipes are cooked again and again in a home kitchen; the weights, timings and tips come from those trials.
About.principleLanguagesBody: Everything is published in Turkish, English and Arabic, so the same recipe can be cooked with the same care in different kitchens.
About.featureRecipes: Serving multipliers, checkable ingredients and printable recipe cards
About.featureEbooks: Focused digital cookbooks in PDF format
About.featureNewsletter: A newsletter with seasonal recipes, twice a month
